properties.name: ai.service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the internal AI microservice (DeepSeek pipeline) used for admin text generation.

properties.name: ocr.service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the internal OCR microservice used to extract Chinese text from images.

properties.name: tts.service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the internal TTS microservice (Google Cloud Text-to-Speech proxy).

properties.name: app.public-url
properties.description: Public origin of the site, used to build absolute URLs (Stripe return URLs, sitemap entries, email links). Production sets https://chinesereads.com via APP_PUBLIC_URL.

properties.name: usage.user.monthly-limit
properties.description: User-text creations (OCR + paste) allowed per FREE user each calendar month.

properties.name: usage.premium.daily-limit
properties.description: Fair-use daily cap per PREMIUM user (premium is exempt from the monthly limit and the global fuse; this only stops a single abusive account).

properties.name: usage.global.daily-limit
properties.description: Global fuse: total FREE/admin text creations across all users per day.

properties.name: usage.text.max-chars
properties.description: Maximum characters per user text; bounds per-generation cost and keeps full-text audio under the TTS cap.

properties.name: tts.max-chars
properties.description: Hard cap of characters per /api/tts request (blocks a single huge synthesis).

properties.name: tts.rate-limit.per-minute
properties.description: Maximum /api/tts requests per client IP per minute.

properties.name: tts.cache.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum entries of the Caffeine cache of synthesized audio (keyed by exact text).

properties.name: tts.cache.ttl-days
properties.description: Days a cached TTS audio stays valid before re-synthesis.

properties.name: usage.audio.word.monthly-limit
properties.description: Monthly single-word audio plays per FREE user (premium and admins are exempt).

properties.name: usage.audio.phrase.monthly-limit
properties.description: Monthly sentence/full-text audio plays per FREE user (the expensive premium draw).

properties.name: usage.chat.monthly-limit
properties.description: Monthly AI contextual word-chat messages per FREE user (paid DeepSeek per message).

properties.name: reminder.enabled
properties.description: Kill switch of the daily SRS review-reminder email, independent of the Brevo credentials.

properties.name: reminder.cron
properties.description: Spring cron (6 fields: sec min hour day-of-month month day-of-week) that fires the review-reminder job. Emails can only go out when the job runs, and never more than one per user per day.

properties.name: reminder.zone
properties.description: Time zone of the reminder cron AND of what "today" means for the due-count and the once-per-day guarantee.

properties.name: brevo.api-key
properties.description: Brevo API v3 key (xkeysib-...). SECRET: lives in docker/.env, never committed. Empty disables all email sending.

properties.name: mail.from
properties.description: Verified sender address for outgoing email (its domain must pass SPF/DKIM in Brevo). Empty disables all email sending.

properties.name: mail.from-name
properties.description: Display name shown in inboxes as the email sender.

properties.name: stripe.secret-key
properties.description: Stripe secret API key. SECRET: lives in docker/.env, never committed. Empty disables billing.

properties.name: stripe.webhook-secret
properties.description: Stripe webhook signing secret used to verify /api/premium/webhook calls. SECRET: lives in docker/.env.

properties.name: stripe.price.monthly
properties.description: Stripe recurring Price ID of the monthly PREMIUM plan.

properties.name: stripe.price.yearly
properties.description: Stripe recurring Price ID of the yearly PREMIUM plan.

properties.name: influencer.payout.monthly-cents
properties.description: Influencer commission per COLLECTED monthly charge, in cents (settlements view).

properties.name: influencer.payout.yearly-cents
properties.description: Influencer commission per COLLECTED yearly charge, in cents (settlements view).
